messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | GCC Mining, Energy, ESG & Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Little,

I am reaching out after an earlier message to the former Potential Max domain failed. I noted CIEL HR's current Middle East recruitment activity and wanted to place my executive profile directly with you.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership remit spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major international mining operation.

I work across ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities, industry bodies and senior corporate leadership. My current scope also includes governance and external positioning around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-accounting work and wider sustainability priorities.

I am exploring senior mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations leadership roles. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

My current GCC executive CV is attached. I would appreciate consideration for relevant leadership searches across mining, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure and industrial sectors, or referral to the appropriate CIEL HR executive-search colleague.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
